controls.title: Organizational Context
controls.description: The organizational mission is understood and informs cybersecurity risk management.
assessment_objectives: Determine if the organizational mission is understood and informs cybersecurity risk management

controls.title: Internal Stakeholders
controls.description: Internal stakeholders understand and contribute to cybersecurity risk management.
assessment_objectives: Determine if internal stakeholders understand and contribute to cybersecurity risk management

controls.title: Legal and Regulatory Requirements
controls.description: Legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements regarding cybersecurity — including privacy and civil liberties obligations — are understood and managed.
assessment_objectives: Determine if legal, regulatory, and contractual cybersecurity requirements are understood and managed

controls.title: Critical Objectives
controls.description: Critical objectives, capabilities, and services that stakeholders depend on or expect from the organization are understood and communicated.
assessment_objectives: Determine if critical objectives, capabilities, and services are understood and communicated

controls.title: Outcomes and Dependencies
controls.description: Outcomes, capabilities, and services that the organization depends on are understood and communicated.
assessment_objectives: Determine if organizational dependencies are understood and communicated

controls.title: Risk Management Objectives
controls.description: Risk management objectives are established and agreed to by organizational stakeholders.
assessment_objectives: Determine if risk management objectives are established and agreed to by organizational stakeholders

controls.title: Risk Appetite and Tolerance
controls.description: Risk appetite and risk tolerance statements are established, communicated, and maintained.
assessment_objectives: Determine if risk appetite and risk tolerance statements are established, communicated, and maintained

controls.title: Enterprise Risk Management Integration
controls.description: Cybersecurity risk management activities and outcomes are included in enterprise risk management processes.
assessment_objectives: Determine if cybersecurity risk management activities and outcomes are included in enterprise risk management processes

controls.title: Strategic Direction
controls.description: Strategic direction that describes appropriate risk response options is established and communicated.
assessment_objectives: Determine if strategic direction describing appropriate risk response options is established and communicated

controls.title: Risk Communication Lines
controls.description: Lines of communication across the organization are established for cybersecurity risks, including risks from suppliers and other third parties.
assessment_objectives: Determine if lines of communication for cybersecurity risks are established across the organization

controls.title: Standardized Risk Management
controls.description: A standardized method for calculating, documenting, categorizing, and prioritizing cybersecurity risks is established and communicated.
assessment_objectives: Determine if a standardized method for calculating, documenting, categorizing, and prioritizing cybersecurity risks is established

controls.title: Opportunity Management
controls.description: Strategic opportunities (i.e., positive risks) are characterized and are included in organizational cybersecurity risk discussions.
assessment_objectives: Determine if strategic opportunities are characterized and included in cybersecurity risk discussions

controls.title: Organizational Leadership
controls.description: Organizational leadership is responsible and accountable for cybersecurity risk and fosters a culture that is risk-aware, ethical, and continually improving.
assessment_objectives: Determine if organizational leadership is responsible and accountable for cybersecurity risk
Determine if organizational leadership fosters a culture that is risk-aware, ethical, and continually improving

controls.title: Roles, Responsibilities, and Authorities
controls.description: Roles, responsibilities, and authorities related to cybersecurity risk management are established, communicated, understood, and enforced.
assessment_objectives: Determine if cybersecurity roles, responsibilities, and authorities are established, communicated, understood, and enforced

controls.title: Adequate Resources
controls.description: Adequate resources are allocated commensurate with the cybersecurity risk strategy, roles, responsibilities, and policies.
assessment_objectives: Determine if adequate resources are allocated commensurate with cybersecurity risk strategy, roles, responsibilities, and policies

controls.title: Cybersecurity in HR Practices
controls.description: Cybersecurity is included in human resources practices.
assessment_objectives: Determine if cybersecurity is included in human resources practices

controls.title: Cybersecurity Policy
controls.description: A policy for managing cybersecurity risks is established based on organizational context, cybersecurity strategy, and priorities and is communicated and enforced.
assessment_objectives: Determine if a cybersecurity risk management policy is established and communicated
Determine if the policy is enforced

controls.title: Policy Review Process
controls.description: The cybersecurity policy is reviewed, updated, communicated, and enforced to reflect changes in requirements, threats, technology, and organizational mission.
assessment_objectives: Determine if the cybersecurity policy is reviewed and updated to reflect changes

controls.title: Supply Chain Risk Management Program
controls.description: A cybersecurity supply chain risk management program, strategy, objectives, policies, and processes are established and agreed to by organizational stakeholders.
assessment_objectives: Determine if a cybersecurity supply chain risk management program is established

controls.title: Supply Chain Risk Assessment
controls.description: Cybersecurity roles and responsibilities for suppliers, customers, and partners are established, communicated, and coordinated internally and externally.
assessment_objectives: Determine if cybersecurity roles and responsibilities for suppliers, customers, and partners are established and communicated

controls.title: Supply Chain Risk Integration
controls.description: Cybersecurity supply chain risk management is integrated into cybersecurity and enterprise risk management, risk assessment, and improvement processes.
assessment_objectives: Determine if supply chain risk management is integrated into broader risk management processes

controls.title: Supplier Due Diligence
controls.description: Suppliers are known and prioritized by criticality.
assessment_objectives: Determine if suppliers are known and prioritized by criticality

controls.title: Supply Chain Requirements
controls.description: Requirements to address cybersecurity risks in supply chains are established, prioritized, and integrated into contracts and other types of agreements with suppliers and other relevant third parties.
assessment_objectives: Determine if cybersecurity requirements are integrated into contracts with suppliers

controls.title: Supply Chain Planning and Due Diligence
controls.description: Planning and due diligence are performed to reduce risks before entering into formal supplier or other third-party relationships.
assessment_objectives: Determine if planning and due diligence are performed before entering into supplier relationships

controls.title: Supply Chain Risk Management Activities
controls.description: The risks posed by a supplier, their products and services, and other third parties are understood, recorded, prioritized, assessed, responded to, and monitored over the course of the relationship.
assessment_objectives: Determine if supplier risks are continuously assessed and monitored

controls.title: Supply Chain Incident Response
controls.description: Relevant suppliers and other third parties are included in incident planning, response, and recovery activities.
assessment_objectives: Determine if relevant suppliers are included in incident planning, response, and recovery activities

controls.title: Supply Chain Security Practices
controls.description: Supply chain security practices are integrated into cybersecurity and enterprise risk management programs, and their performance is monitored throughout the technology product and service life cycle.
assessment_objectives: Determine if supply chain security practices are integrated and monitored throughout the lifecycle

controls.title: Supply Chain Risk Management Plan
controls.description: Cybersecurity supply chain risk management plans include provisions for activities that occur after the conclusion of a partnership or service agreement.
assessment_objectives: Determine if supply chain risk management plans include post-relationship provisions

controls.title: Hardware Inventory
controls.description: Inventories of hardware managed by the organization are maintained.
assessment_objectives: Determine if inventories of hardware managed by the organization are maintained

controls.title: Software Inventory
controls.description: Inventories of software, services, and systems managed by the organization are maintained.
assessment_objectives: Determine if inventories of software, services, and systems are maintained

controls.title: Network Communication and Data Flows
controls.description: Representations of the organization's authorized network communication and internal and external network data flows are maintained.
assessment_objectives: Determine if representations of authorized network communication and data flows are maintained

controls.title: External Service Inventory
controls.description: Inventories of services provided by suppliers are maintained.
assessment_objectives: Determine if inventories of services provided by suppliers are maintained

controls.title: Asset Prioritization
controls.description: Assets are prioritized based on classification, criticality, resources, and impact to the mission.
assessment_objectives: Determine if assets are prioritized based on classification, criticality, resources, and impact

controls.title: Data Inventory and Classification
controls.description: Inventories of data and corresponding metadata for designated data types are maintained.
assessment_objectives: Determine if inventories of data and corresponding metadata are maintained

controls.title: System Categorization
controls.description: Systems, hardware, software, services, and data are managed throughout their life cycles.
assessment_objectives: Determine if systems, hardware, software, services, and data are managed throughout their life cycles

controls.title: Vulnerability Identification
controls.description: Vulnerabilities in assets are identified, validated, and recorded.
assessment_objectives: Determine if vulnerabilities in assets are identified, validated, and recorded

controls.title: Threat Intelligence
controls.description: Cyber threat intelligence is received from information sharing forums and sources.
assessment_objectives: Determine if cyber threat intelligence is received from information sharing forums and sources

controls.title: Threat Identification
controls.description: Internal and external threats to the organization are identified and recorded.
assessment_objectives: Determine if internal and external threats are identified and recorded

controls.title: Impact and Likelihood Determination
controls.description: Potential impacts and likelihoods of threats exploiting vulnerabilities are identified and recorded.
assessment_objectives: Determine if potential impacts and likelihoods of threats exploiting vulnerabilities are identified and recorded

controls.title: Risk Response
controls.description: Threats, vulnerabilities, likelihoods, and impacts are used to understand inherent risk and inform risk response prioritization.
assessment_objectives: Determine if risk responses are prioritized based on threats, vulnerabilities, likelihoods, and impacts

controls.title: Risk Response Selection
controls.description: Risk responses are chosen, prioritized, planned, tracked, and communicated.
assessment_objectives: Determine if risk responses are chosen, prioritized, planned, tracked, and communicated

controls.title: Risk Changes
controls.description: Changes and exceptions are managed, assessed for risk impact, recorded, and tracked.
assessment_objectives: Determine if changes and exceptions are managed, assessed for risk impact, recorded, and tracked

controls.title: Vulnerability Disclosure and Response
controls.description: Processes for receiving, analyzing, and responding to vulnerability disclosures are established.
assessment_objectives: Determine if processes for receiving, analyzing, and responding to vulnerability disclosures are established

controls.title: Hardware and Software Integrity
controls.description: The authenticity and integrity of hardware and software are assessed prior to acquisition and use.
assessment_objectives: Determine if the authenticity and integrity of hardware and software are assessed prior to acquisition and use

controls.title: Critical Supplier Assessment
controls.description: Critical suppliers are assessed prior to acquisition.
assessment_objectives: Determine if critical suppliers are assessed prior to acquisition

controls.title: Improvement from Evaluations
controls.description: Improvements are identified from evaluations.
assessment_objectives: Determine if improvements are identified from evaluations

controls.title: Improvement from Testing
controls.description: Improvements are identified from security tests and exercises, including those done in coordination with suppliers and relevant third parties.
assessment_objectives: Determine if improvements are identified from security tests and exercises

controls.title: Improvement from Operations
controls.description: Improvements are identified from execution of operational processes, procedures, and activities.
assessment_objectives: Determine if improvements are identified from operational execution

controls.title: Incident Lessons Learned
controls.description: Incident response plans and other cybersecurity plans that affect operations are established, communicated, maintained, and improved.
assessment_objectives: Determine if cybersecurity plans affecting operations are established, communicated, maintained, and improved

controls.title: Identity Management
controls.description: Identities and credentials for authorized users, services, and hardware are managed by the organization.
assessment_objectives: Determine if identities and credentials for authorized users, services, and hardware are managed

controls.title: Identity Proofing
controls.description: Identities are proofed and bound to credentials based on the context of interactions.
assessment_objectives: Determine if identities are proofed and bound to credentials based on context

controls.title: Authentication
controls.description: Users, services, and hardware are authenticated.
assessment_objectives: Determine if users, services, and hardware are authenticated

controls.title: Identity Assertions
controls.description: Identity assertions are protected, conveyed, and verified.
assessment_objectives: Determine if identity assertions are protected, conveyed, and verified

controls.title: Access Permissions
controls.description: Access permissions, entitlements, and authorizations are defined in a policy, managed, enforced, and reviewed, and incorporate the principles of least privilege and separation of duties.
assessment_objectives: Determine if access permissions are managed and enforce least privilege and separation of duties

controls.title: Physical Access Management
controls.description: Physical access to assets is managed, monitored, and enforced commensurate with risk.
assessment_objectives: Determine if physical access to assets is managed, monitored, and enforced commensurate with risk

controls.title: Awareness and Training
controls.description: Personnel are provided awareness and training so that they possess the knowledge and skills to perform general tasks with cybersecurity risks in mind.
assessment_objectives: Determine if personnel are provided awareness and training regarding cybersecurity risks

controls.title: Specialized Role Training
controls.description: Individuals in specialized roles are provided awareness and training so that they possess the knowledge and skills to perform relevant tasks with cybersecurity risks in mind.
assessment_objectives: Determine if individuals in specialized roles are provided role-specific training

controls.title: Data-at-Rest Protection
controls.description: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-at-rest are protected.
assessment_objectives: Determine if the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-at-rest are protected

controls.title: Data-in-Transit Protection
controls.description: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-transit are protected.
assessment_objectives: Determine if the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-transit are protected

controls.title: Data-in-Use Protection
controls.description: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-use are protected.
assessment_objectives: Determine if the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-use are protected

controls.title: Data Backup
controls.description: Backups of data are created, protected, maintained, and tested.
assessment_objectives: Determine if backups of data are created, protected, maintained, and tested

controls.title: Configuration Management
controls.description: Configuration management practices are established and applied.
assessment_objectives: Determine if configuration management practices are established and applied

controls.title: Software Maintenance
controls.description: Software is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk.
assessment_objectives: Determine if software is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk

controls.title: Hardware Maintenance
controls.description: Hardware is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk.
assessment_objectives: Determine if hardware is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk

controls.title: Log Generation
controls.description: Log records are generated and made available for continuous monitoring.
assessment_objectives: Determine if log records are generated and made available for continuous monitoring

controls.title: Software Installation Restrictions
controls.description: Installation and execution of unauthorized software are prevented.
assessment_objectives: Determine if installation and execution of unauthorized software are prevented

controls.title: Secure Software Development
controls.description: Secure software development practices are integrated, and their performance is monitored throughout the software development life cycle.
assessment_objectives: Determine if secure software development practices are integrated and monitored

controls.title: Network Protection
controls.description: Networks and environments are protected from unauthorized logical access and usage.
assessment_objectives: Determine if networks and environments are protected from unauthorized logical access and usage

controls.title: Technology Infrastructure Resilience
controls.description: The organization's technology assets are protected from environmental threats.
assessment_objectives: Determine if technology assets are protected from environmental threats

controls.title: Security Architecture
controls.description: Security architectures are managed commensurate with risk.
assessment_objectives: Determine if security architectures are managed commensurate with risk

controls.title: Adequate Resource Capacity
controls.description: Adequate resource capacity to ensure availability is maintained.
assessment_objectives: Determine if adequate resource capacity to ensure availability is maintained

controls.title: Network Monitoring
controls.description: Networks and network services are monitored to find potentially adverse events.
assessment_objectives: Determine if networks and network services are monitored to find potentially adverse events

controls.title: Physical Environment Monitoring
controls.description: The physical environment is monitored to find potentially adverse events.
assessment_objectives: Determine if the physical environment is monitored to find potentially adverse events

controls.title: Personnel Activity Monitoring
controls.description: Personnel activity and technology usage are monitored to find potentially adverse events.
assessment_objectives: Determine if personnel activity and technology usage are monitored to find potentially adverse events

controls.title: External Service Provider Monitoring
controls.description: External service provider activities and services are monitored to find potentially adverse events.
assessment_objectives: Determine if external service provider activities and services are monitored

controls.title: Computing Hardware and Software Monitoring
controls.description: Computing hardware and software, runtime environments, and their data are monitored to find potentially adverse events.
assessment_objectives: Determine if computing hardware, software, and runtime environments are monitored

controls.title: Adverse Event Analysis
controls.description: Potentially adverse events are analyzed to better understand associated activities.
assessment_objectives: Determine if potentially adverse events are analyzed to better understand associated activities

controls.title: Event Correlation and Enrichment
controls.description: Information is correlated from multiple sources.
assessment_objectives: Determine if information is correlated from multiple sources

controls.title: Impact Estimation
controls.description: The estimated impact and scope of adverse events are understood.
assessment_objectives: Determine if the estimated impact and scope of adverse events are understood

controls.title: Incident Declaration
controls.description: Information on adverse events is provided to authorized staff and tools.
assessment_objectives: Determine if information on adverse events is provided to authorized staff and tools

controls.title: Cyber Threat Information Integration
controls.description: Cyber threat intelligence and other contextual information are integrated into the analysis.
assessment_objectives: Determine if cyber threat intelligence is integrated into the analysis

controls.title: Incident Declared
controls.description: Incidents are declared when adverse events meet the defined incident criteria.
assessment_objectives: Determine if incidents are declared when adverse events meet defined criteria

controls.title: Incident Management
controls.description: The incident response plan is executed in coordination with relevant third parties once an incident is declared.
assessment_objectives: Determine if the incident response plan is executed in coordination with relevant third parties

controls.title: Incident Triage
controls.description: Incidents are categorized and prioritized.
assessment_objectives: Determine if incidents are categorized and prioritized

controls.title: Incident Escalation and Elevation
controls.description: Incidents are escalated or elevated as needed.
assessment_objectives: Determine if incidents are escalated or elevated as needed

controls.title: Incident Closure
controls.description: Incidents are closed once the criteria for response completion have been met.
assessment_objectives: Determine if incidents are closed once criteria for response completion have been met

controls.title: Forensic Investigation Criteria
controls.description: The criteria for initiating incident recovery are applied.
assessment_objectives: Determine if criteria for initiating incident recovery are applied

controls.title: Root Cause Analysis
controls.description: Analysis is performed to determine what has taken place during an incident and root cause of the incident.
assessment_objectives: Determine if root cause analysis is performed during incidents

controls.title: Actions Performed Recording
controls.description: Actions performed during an investigation are recorded, and the records' integrity and provenance are preserved.
assessment_objectives: Determine if investigation actions are recorded and integrity preserved

controls.title: Incident Data Collection and Preservation
controls.description: Incident data and metadata are collected, and their integrity and provenance are preserved.
assessment_objectives: Determine if incident data and metadata are collected with integrity preserved

controls.title: Incident Scope Estimation
controls.description: An incident's magnitude is estimated and validated.
assessment_objectives: Determine if an incident's magnitude is estimated and validated

controls.title: Internal Stakeholder Notification
controls.description: Internal and external stakeholders are notified of incidents.
assessment_objectives: Determine if internal and external stakeholders are notified of incidents

controls.title: Information Sharing
controls.description: Information is shared with designated internal and external stakeholders.
assessment_objectives: Determine if information is shared with designated stakeholders

controls.title: Incident Containment
controls.description: Incidents are contained.
assessment_objectives: Determine if incidents are contained

controls.title: Incident Eradication
controls.description: Incidents are eradicated.
assessment_objectives: Determine if incidents are eradicated

controls.title: Recovery Plan Execution
controls.description: The recovery portion of the incident response plan is executed once initiated from the incident response process.
assessment_objectives: Determine if the recovery portion of the incident response plan is executed

controls.title: Recovery Selection and Execution
controls.description: Recovery actions are selected, scoped, prioritized, and performed.
assessment_objectives: Determine if recovery actions are selected, scoped, prioritized, and performed

controls.title: Backup Integrity Verification
controls.description: The integrity of backups and other restoration assets is verified before using them for restoration.
assessment_objectives: Determine if the integrity of backups and restoration assets is verified before use

controls.title: Mission Function Consideration
controls.description: Critical mission functions and cybersecurity risk management are considered to establish post-incident operational norms.
assessment_objectives: Determine if critical mission functions are considered in establishing post-incident operational norms

controls.title: Restoration Verification
controls.description: The integrity of restored assets is verified, systems and services are restored, and normal operating status is confirmed.
assessment_objectives: Determine if the integrity of restored assets is verified and normal operations confirmed

controls.title: End of Recovery Declaration
controls.description: The end of incident recovery is declared based on criteria, and incident-related documentation is completed.
assessment_objectives: Determine if the end of recovery is declared and documentation completed

controls.title: Recovery Communication
controls.description: Recovery activities and progress in restoring operational capabilities are communicated to designated internal and external stakeholders.
assessment_objectives: Determine if recovery activities and progress are communicated to stakeholders

controls.title: Public Updates
controls.description: Public updates on incident recovery are shared using approved methods and messaging.
assessment_objectives: Determine if public updates on incident recovery use approved methods and messaging
